source: FRESH ledsone (dbhub_readonly, SELECT only) — direct September aggregation over the assigned population, grouped independently of build/build.mjs. Supersedes evidence/extract-2026-09-29/sales-reconciliation.json, which came from the stale order_management_copy mirror.
population_rule: utharsika's PH eBay product assignment (staff.ph_categories user_id=109 -> staff.ph_category_products source_id=2), restricted to the six approved business account groups. September sales are NOT required — assigned products with no September sales remain visible at LY 0 / TY 0.
note: Fresh LEDsone rebuild 2026-09-29. LY is unchanged from the mirror on every aggregate (ly_sales 3182.15, ly_orders 235) — proof the rebuilt query is faithful. TY rose by the days the mirror was missing: sales +29.78 (all Ledsone/GBP/Lamp Shade), ty_ad_sales +33.20, ad_spend +3.20, impressions +7586, clicks +14.

metric_definitions.sales: order_management.orders x order_item_info, SUM(item_quantity*item_price), eBay accounts, status NOT IN (Cancelled,Refunded)
metric_definitions.orders: business_reports.ebay_traffic_data.quantity_sold — eBay-reported units sold (NOT OMS units, NOT distinct order count)
metric_definitions.conversion: quantity_sold / ebay_views * 100 — algebraically identical to eBay STR
metric_definitions.avg_price: ASP = status-filtered Sales / OMS units sold (no historical listing price exists in ledsone)
metric_definitions.ly_ad_generated: ebay_order_expenses AD_FEE (DISTINCT order_id+item_id, order_id<>'0') matched to the purchased order line; the line REVENUE is the value, never the fee
metric_definitions.ty_ad_generated: Pending — AD_FEE available through 2026-09-03 only (3 of 29 days, 12.8% of TY sales by value)
metric_definitions.ad_sales: listing_performance.sale_amount_listing_currency — eBay ATTRIBUTED ad sales, never subtracted from Total Sales
metric_definitions.roas: SUM(ad_sales)/SUM(ad_spend) — never an average of row-level rates
metric_definitions.sku_image: listings.ebay_listings.main_image_url, one per account+item_id, http rewritten to https
metric_definitions.traffic_coverage: LY 28 of 30 September 2025 days; TY 27 available September 2026 days
